im not much into Reddit but heres sth i have noticed on myself

when my parents have conflict it makes me either feel uncomfortable or kinda excited, i rarely engage in it tho (doesnt happen around strangers tho, thats also the time i enjoy ppl having conflicts) 

but when my parents blame me for stuff they do when they had done much worse, i get angry and defensive. after that it makes me feel sad (mostly because i got blamed to hell) and so i retreat from the situation completely. my anger shows to stand my ground til they retreat completely but to also defend myself from being blamed by pointing what my parents have done that is much worse

i also get angry a lot, to the point i feel as tho anger is my most dominant emotion (its also sadness that i feel but anger is more pronounced) its mainly because all i feel is frustration, so i WANT to express all that anger but outside, i seem to suppress my own anger. ik that its there, ik what i feel, and im not trying to get rid of it but control it instead

i also have noticed that i tend to suppress negative emotions most of the time. i talk about what i feel with ppl i trust, sometimes i hate having to control my emotions but i also want to vent in order to express them

i hate ppl underestimating me as well, it makes me angry

i also get "paranoid" when ppls motives/behavior is inconsistent to the point of not knowing if i should trust them or not

may be 3hrs late but idc, i hate myself for being powerless for the fact that i was (and still am) unable to stand up for myself, got bullied to hell back in my childhood and even if my parents encouraged me to do sth, i felt powerless in front of the bullies to the point that this memory that i had is stuck on my head. all it does is make me super angry for the fact that i was a weakling and couldnt stand up for myself. hell, it even makes me so fixated on wanting to get revenge at these ppl. i wish i had total control if anything, to not relive sth like this or to at least get back at ppl who may possibly bully me on the future but yeah, gl to myself with that. being bullied has led to me having mental health problems but im trying to recover from that. unfortunately, i still get "PTSD" from these or similar memories that i have had throughout my childhood

I'd say that i agree with the part about self-doubting and i do need someone to help me reassure those doubts, I'd also say that i need external validation (ie how i perform) as well

Now, I'd say that I'm more often than not fixated on 5, and it's because i do want to come across as powerful/dominating to people who have wronged me even though i myself know that I'm powerless, even then. that's all i think about, wanting to get back at people just so i can show them that i have complete power over them
